sloka: कल्माषपादो हि अभवत् तस्मात् जातः तु शङ्खणः ।सुदर्शनः शंखणस्य अग्निवर्णः सुदर्शनात् ॥१-७०-४०॥
transliteration: kalmāṣapādo hi abhavat tasmāt jātaḥ tu śaṅkhaṇaḥ ।sudarśanaḥ śaṁkhaṇasya agnivarṇaḥ sudarśanāt ॥1-70-40॥

translations.english: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.
